# #622 — validate-pr-body.ts: empty/unset PR_BODY path can print failures while exiting 0

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: bug

Updated: 2026-08-08T04:26:56Z

---

Observed by the #613 lane (PR #620 report, 2026-08-08): invoking scripts/validate-pr-body.ts without PR_BODY set (it reads env, not argv — an easy mistake) validated the empty string, printed failure lines, and exited 0 in that path. A caller checking only the exit code reads a hard failure as a pass — the silent-adjustment class AGENTS.md now bans.

Ask: unset/empty PR_BODY must be a distinct loud error with non-zero exit (harness misuse, not validation pass or fail). Add a regression case. Also worth asserting the exit code is non-zero on EVERY error path — the observed one may not be alone.

Done means: running the validator with PR_BODY unset exits non-zero naming the misuse; with a failing body exits non-zero; with a passing body exits 0 printing the pass line. Red-first on current behavior.

State: observed by one lane + consistent with the controller's own earlier empty-string run this session (printed 'validation failed' lines, echoed exit 0). PROPOSED until reproduced under the ticket.
